with "no producer inspected". If true, the goal below closes with NO hchi hypothesis.
My original probe HAD hchi as a binder, so it measured only the conversion

MUST FAIL: same, with a representation at n in scope.
MUST SUCCEED (the honest statement): the equivalence.

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

universe u

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

/-- MUST FAIL: no hypothesis links n to the curve. -/
example (n : ℕ) : (n : ℤ) = genus C := by
  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
  have h : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - genus C := chi_moduleKSheaf C
  omega

    (_rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D) : (n : ℤ) = genus C := by
  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
  have h : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - genus C := chi_moduleKSheaf C
  omega

/-- MUST SUCCEED: what chi_moduleKSheaf actually gives is an EQUIVALENCE. -/
example (n : ℕ) :
    (letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
      Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ)) ↔ (n : ℤ) = genus C := by
  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
  have h : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - genus C := chi_moduleKSheaf C
  constructor <;> intro hh <;> omega
